Every model each gateway advertises through its public model-list endpoint, unified into one matrix so you can see which gateways route a given model and what each charges per million tokens.

Pricing is not guaranteed to be accurate — rates change frequently, and this benchmark runs weekly, so treat this as a directional comparison and confirm current pricing with the gateway before making a decision.
